digest.component_or_area: plan review gate / LLM command interface
propositions: Plan review passed but signature failed to persist is classified as retryable only in CLI, not in MCP, causing MCP agents to incorrectly treat it as success.
MCP endpoint returns raw rebar.llm.review_plan result without inspecting signature presence or discriminating between transient vs non-transient failures.
MCP agents encountering passed-but-unsigned state proceed to claim gate, which rejects because signature was never written.
The passed-but-unsigned classification logic must be extracted to a shared location below both CLI and MCP frontends.
MCP result must include structured retryable flag and reference sign_review as recovery action to inform agents.
CLI must maintain byte-identical exit 11 behavior and stderr output after extraction.
